title: loxoma maculatum
intro: Loxoma maculatum, commonly known as Spilanthes, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which can aid in treating wounds, infections, and other health issues. The therapeutic actions of Spilanthes include its ability to stimulate saliva production, making it a potential remedy for sore throats and mouth ulcers. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
